question: The Sattriya dance has developed from the monasteries of:
solution:
The correct answer is __Assam__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**Sattriya Dance: 

__
 
• Sattriya dance, which is one of the famous classical dance traditions of India is from Assam state.
 
• This dance is based on eight principles of heritage. 

Assam: 

 
• Famous for Sattriya dance which is one of the ancient Indian classical dance traditions.
 
• Bihu dance in a festive monsoon.
 
• Famous for Assam tea & Assam silk.
 
• Assam is the first site of oil drilling in Asia.
